---
title: "E-Commerce Big Data Analytics Report"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
params:
  data: NA
  rfm: NA
  rules: NA
  forecast: NA
  sections: NA
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(data.table)
library(knitr)
library(plotly)
```

## Executive Summary
This report presents an overview of the E-Commerce analytics data.

**Total Orders:** `r uniqueN(params$data$Order_ID)`  
**Total Revenue:** $`r formatC(sum(params$data$Sales, na.rm=TRUE), format="f", digits=2, big.mark=",")`  
**Total Customers:** `r uniqueN(params$data$Customer_ID)`  

```{r}
if("Sales Trends" %in% params$sections) {
  cat("## Sales Trends\n")
  monthly <- params$data[, .(Sales = sum(Sales, na.rm=TRUE)), by = .(Month = lubridate::floor_date(Order_Date, "month"))][order(Month)]
  kable(head(monthly, 12), caption = "Recent Monthly Sales")
}
```

```{r}
if("Product Performance" %in% params$sections) {
  cat("## Product Performance\n")
  top_prods <- params$data[, .(Sales = sum(Sales, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(Product_ID, Product_Name)][order(-Sales)][1:10]
  kable(top_prods, caption = "Top 10 Products by Revenue")
}
```

```{r}
if("Customer RFM" %in% params$sections && !is.null(params$rfm)) {
  cat("## RFM Segmentation\n")
  seg_counts <- params$rfm[, .N, by = Segment][order(-N)]
  kable(seg_counts, caption = "Customer Segments")
}
```

```{r}
if("Forecast" %in% params$sections && !is.null(params$forecast)) {
  cat("## Sales Forecast\n")
  kable(params$forecast$table, caption = "Forecast Values")
}
```
